description: This file defines a custom hook 'useReviewEvaluation' for managing performance review evaluations in an HRM system. It includes interfaces for data structures, functions for API interactions, and utility functions for generating validation rules, models, and data transformations related to performance reviews.

methods.name: getAllKpis
methods.description: Fetches all KPIs for a specific review ID.

methods.name: getSupervisorReview
methods.description: Retrieves supervisor evaluation data for a review.

methods.name: getEmployeeReview
methods.description: Retrieves employee evaluation data for a review.

methods.name: getFinalReview
methods.description: Retrieves final evaluation data for a review.

methods.name: finalizeReview
methods.description: Submits final review data to finalize the review process.

methods.name: generateRules
methods.description: Generates validation rules for KPIs based on min and max ratings.

methods.name: generateModel
methods.description: Creates an initial review model with KPI IDs and null ratings/comments.

methods.name: generateEvaluationFormData
methods.description: Transforms evaluation data into form data structure.

methods.name: generateReviewerData
methods.description: Transforms reviewer data into a structured format.

methods.name: generateAllowedActions
methods.description: Creates a map of allowed actions for review workflows.
